_lisezmoi: Every figure the site shows comes from the federal files named here (IPEDS and College Scorecard), built by scripts/build-data.py into colleges.json and states.json, or from this file. Nothing is typed into a page. Manual rebuild when NCES or the Department of Education publish new files: no schedule is promised (RECETTE §4, §12.1).
source: IPEDS data files HD2024, IC2023_AY and EF2023A_DIST (NCES) and the College Scorecard most-recent-cohorts institution file released on November 2, 2026 (U.S. Department of Education)

scorecard.license: CC-BY (catalog.data.gov record for College Scorecard, publisher OPEPD)
scorecard.awardNote: OMAWDP8_ALL: share of all entering students (first-time and transfer, full- and part-time) with an award within 8 years; students who entered in 2017-18, reported to IPEDS in 2025-26
scorecard.earningsNote: median earnings 10 years after entry of students who entered in 2011-12 and 2012-13, measured in 2022 and 2023, in 2024 dollars

nces.policy: Unless stated otherwise, all information on the U.S. Department of Education's IES website is in the public domain and may be reproduced, published, linked to, or otherwise used without IES' permission.
nces.citation: U.S. Department of Education. Institute of Education Sciences, National Center for Education Statistics. Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS).

credits.note: Typical program lengths used as calculator starting values only (associate about 60 semester credits, bachelor's about 120, master's 30 to 36, doctorate 60 as a round starting value since programs range widely): the catalog of each program sets the real number, which the reader types.

defaults.note: Calculator assumptions, not data: 12 credits a term over two terms is a common part-time-to-full-time pace for working adults; 30 credits is the full-time year used to spread required annual fees over credits. The reader changes them.

programs.rule: A college offers a program fully online at a level when the file counts at least one program of that field and level that can be completed entirely via distance education (…DE plus …DES greater than zero). Prices are the college's general per-credit charge of IC2023_AY (undergraduate for certificates, associate and bachelor's degrees, graduate for master's and doctorates); law: the yearly JD tuition and fees of IC2023_AY (ISPROF9, ISPFEE9, OSPROF9).
programs.lawYearsNote: Calculator starting value: three years is the usual full-time length of a JD; part-time programs take longer, and the school's catalog sets it.
